scope: Primary-source research and visual inspection; third-party PDFs remain local, uncommitted

sources.pages: Printed 443-444; PDF pages 2-3; Figure 2 visually inspected

sources.title: Titan Training Material, Module 1, public university facility copy

sources.title: Williams and Carter, Transmission Electron Microscopy (2009), Chapter 9
sources.pages: Printed 142-147; PDF pages 194-199; Figures 9.5 and 9.6 visually inspected
sources.role: Parallel illumination, objective front focal plane, two-coil shift/tilt and remote virtual pivot

sources.role: Mini/objective coupling, parallel TEM versus focused STEM, manufacturer differences
